figures.caption: Table 2. Fig. 8b shows their ﬁrst-cycle charge-discharge proﬁles for the pelletized and pouch-type NCM622/graphite full-cells at 0.025C at 25 °C and 30 °C, respectively. The ﬁrst-cycle discharge capacities for the pelletized and pouch-type NCM622/graphite full-cells were 121 and 112 mA h gNCM622 electrode −1, respectively, which translates into 190 and 184 W h kg−1 based on total weight of the electrodes (active materials, SEs, carbon additives, polymeric binders, and current col- lectors). In turn, the volumetric energy density of the pouch-type full- cell is calculated to be 432 W h L−1. The NCM622/graphite full-cell also showed a stable cycling performance at 0.025C (the inset in Fig. 8b).
